title: Colts trade Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner; Who's next amid rebuild?
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver recap a franchise-altering day for the Indianapolis Colts, who traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner to the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers, respectively. title: Which college receivers are flying up NFL Draft boards?

title: [FULL EPISODE] Montez Sweat takes responsibility for PED suspension
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Bears defensive end Montez Sweat spoke Tuesday for the first time since his two-game suspension for a violation of the NFL's policy on using performance-enhancing substances. He took full responsibility for what happened, saying it was an accident. Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote hear what Sweat had to say about the incident. Regardless of how the violation happened, Sweat needs to be better for the Bears going forward. Also in this episode, rookie tight end Sam Roush will be taking on a bigger role now that Cole Kmet is out for the season. What are the Bears expecting from him? And the NFL trade deadline is getting closer. Will the Bears make a big splash?
